title: Privacy Policy
intro: Central Reform Congregation (“CRC”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) operates the CRC Music web application (the “Service”). This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service.
informationCollect.heading: Information We Collect
informationCollect.collectFollowingTypes: We collect the following types of information:
informationCollect.accountInformation: {term} Your name, email address, and profile photo when you create an account or sign in.
informationCollect.phoneNumber: {term} If you choose to provide your phone number for SMS scheduling notifications.
informationCollect.musicianProfileData: {term} Your instrument preference, transposition settings, and scheduling availability.
informationCollect.usageData: {term} Information about how you use the Service, including pages visited and features used.
howUseInformation.heading: How We Use Your Information
howUseInformation.sendSchedulingNotifica: Send scheduling notifications via email, SMS, and push notifications
howUseInformation.facilitateMusicianCoor: Facilitate musician coordination and setlist management
smsMobileMessaging.heading: SMS / Mobile Messaging
smsMobileMessaging.optReceiveSms: If you opt in to receive SMS notifications, we will send you text messages related to your scheduling assignments, reminders, and cancellations at Central Reform Congregation.
smsMobileMessaging.mobileInformationIncl: Mobile information, including phone numbers, will not be shared with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes. Mobile information will only be shared with third parties as necessary to deliver the SMS messaging service (i.e., our SMS delivery provider, Twilio).
smsMobileMessaging.messageFrequencyVarie: Message frequency varies based on your scheduling activity. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS notifications at any time through your profile settings or by replying STOP to any message.
dataSharing.heading: Data Sharing
dataSharing.doSellTrade: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We share information only in the following circumstances:
dataSharing.serviceProviders: {term} We use trusted third-party services (Firebase, Resend, Twilio) to operate the Service. These providers only have access to information necessary to perform their functions.
dataSharing.withinCrc: {term} Band leaders and administrators may see your scheduling availability and contact information to coordinate services.
dataSharing.legalRequirements: {term} We may disclose information if required by law.
dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.useIndustryStandard: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), Firebase Authentication, and role-based access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
dataRetention.heading: Data Retention
dataRetention.retainPersonalData: We retain your personal data only for as long as you maintain an account with the Service. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.accessPersonalInformation: Access the personal information we hold about you
rights.requestDeletionAccount: Request deletion of your account and data
rights.optOutSms: Opt out of SMS notifications at any time
rights.optOutEmail: Opt out of email notifications at any time
childrensPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.serviceIntendedUse: The Service is not intended for use by anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
changesPolicy.heading: Changes to This Policy
changesPolicy.updatePrivacyPolicy: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date.
contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.haveQuestionsAbout: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact Central Reform Congregation at {link}.
